name: Ilendra
backstory: One of the professors of the reopened University of Tyrnea, though she teaches children rather than adults — the university is currently multipurpose, the only educational building in town, so she's the one in charge of raising the youth through their first studies.

items: era_ensayo: Predicciones para el anio 1000 d.V.
inhabitant: Saltamontabiras (cross-locality travelers/routes (named, with a mode of travel))

criterion.standard: counts it worthwhile only if the children she's raising actually carry something of it forward
criterion.wasted_life: one spent teaching a generation nothing worth them remembering her for
criterion.trusts: what a child can already do, not what they say they've learned
criterion.distrusts: a lesson repeated back word for word with nothing understood underneath

routines.routine_actions: teaches the youngest students their letters and sums in whichever room isn't booked by the professors that hour, keeps a slate of who's actually keeping up
brings the class through on quiet mornings, less for doctrine than to give them somewhere still to sit and listen
unwinds in the evening once the last parent's collected the last child, trades notes with other newcomers about how the town's actually holding together

arc.premise: Ilendra wants a room of the university actually set aside for the youngest students, instead of borrowing whichever lecture hall the professors aren't using that hour. Resolution: the town approves a dedicated children's wing, or it doesn't, and her class keeps meeting wherever there's a free room that week.
